values.Description:
Hello Kitty Birthday Decoration Kit (46 Pieces) - Birthday Party Set

This 46 piece birthday decoration kit is made for kids birthday parties and girls birthday celebrations with a dark pink and pastel pink colour setup. The arrangement combines balloons with a Happy Birthday banner, a Kitty foil balloon and metallic curtain backdrop pieces so the main party wall has coordinated decoration for cake cutting and photographs.

Use this birthday room decoration at home, in a hotel room, at a banquet hall or at a party venue where you have a suitable wall area for the backdrop. The balloon display can frame the decorated space while the two curtain pieces form the background and the banner and Kitty foil balloon add the birthday message and character element for photos.

WHAT YOU GET (46 Pieces)
20 Dark Pink Colour Balloons
20 Pastel Pink Colour Balloons
1 Happy Birthday Banner
1 Kitty Foil Balloon
2 Pink Colour Metallic Curtains
1 Glue Tape
1 Arch Tape

KEY FEATURES
Two Balloon Colours - Lets you alternate dark pink and pastel pink balloons across the display
Happy Birthday Banner - Places the birthday message clearly at the centre of the decorated wall
Kitty Foil Balloon - Adds the character focal point beside the banner or balloon arrangement
Metallic Curtain Backdrop - Gives the photo and cake cutting area a reflective hanging background
Arch Tape and Glue Tape - Helps arrange balloons and position decoration pieces during setup

PERFECT FOR
Girls Birthday Decoration Items
Kids Birthday Party Decoration
Birthday Room Decoration
Home Birthday Decoration Items
Hotel Room Birthday Decoration
Banquet Hall Birthday Setup
Photo Backdrop Decoration
Kitty Theme Birthday Decor

WHY CHOOSE THIS KIT

The pack brings the main wall decoration pieces and setup aids together in one 46 piece birthday balloon combo. The 20 dark pink colour balloons and 20 pastel pink colour balloons can be arranged around the backdrop to create a two-tone border or curved balloon display. The Happy Birthday banner provides the printed birthday wording, while the Kitty foil balloon can be positioned as the main character piece.

The two pink colour metallic curtains are intended for the backdrop area behind the banner and balloon arrangement. They help define the photo area for birthday pictures and cake cutting without adding unrelated room items to the pack. The included arch tape supports balloon placement for a curved arrangement, and the glue tape can help position suitable decoration pieces while you build the setup.

This kit suits a home party when you want one decorated wall behind the cake table area, and it can also be used for hotel room decoration, banquet hall decoration or a birthday party venue with suitable fixing space. The dark and pastel pink colour combination works as a clear pink theme, while the banner and Kitty foil balloon make the setup specifically suited to a birthday celebration.

For a simple setup, first choose the wall or backdrop area and hang the two metallic curtain pieces. Position the Happy Birthday banner where the wording remains easy to see, then place the Kitty foil balloon as a focal decoration. Inflate the balloons and feed them into the arch tape in the arrangement you prefer. Use the glue tape where suitable to help position the decoration.

Inflate the balloons and fix the arch tape to shape the display.
